name: Workhorse checkouts
responsibility: Names the checkout a coordinator call gives work to, and starts that checkout's workhorse when a delegation finds none
description: The checkout a path names is the directory that holds the vault the path resolves to, by real path and in the layout the server serves: a directory that holds a .archboard/vault, or the directory that holds a vault the path is. So a checkout reached through a link, and a vault that is itself a link, name the checkout of the pane in it; a vault whose link leads out of the layout names none. Of the coordinator's tools only a delegation starts a workhorse; the other three refuse a checkout that has none. A workhorse that cannot be built or started, because its tab has gone, leaves the delegation to refuse, so the coordinator's turn is always answered.

outgoing.label: start its thread when it has none that can run turns
